title: Derivative of a directional derivative of a C^2 map (symmetry of the second derivative)
statement: Let n, l be natural numbers, U an open subset of R^n, v : R^n -> R^l of class C^2 on U and e ∈ R^n. Then for every x ∈ U the derivative at x of the directional derivative v_e(z) := Dv(z) e equals the second derivative of v at x applied to e: D(v_e)(x) = D(Dv)(x) e in L(R^n, R^l), i.e. fderiv ℝ (fun z => fderiv ℝ v z e) x = fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ v) x e.
lean_statement: ∀ (n ℓ : ℕ) (U : Set (Rn n)) (v : Rn n → Rn ℓ) (e : Rn n), IsOpen U → ContDiffOn ℝ 2 v U → ∀ x ∈ U, fderiv ℝ (fun z => fderiv ℝ v z e) x = fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ v) x e
